title: Gemini 3 Flash and GPT-5 behave more predictably
summary:
A model-tuning day: Gemini 3 Flash became the default, audio unlocked its full voice set, and the builder tools got clearer.

Gemini 3 Flash is now the default Gemini model, with its preview route pointed at the global region for broader availability. Azure-hosted GPT-5 models also stop having their temperature setting forcibly overridden. Model routing: still mostly plumbing, until it is your plumbing.

The OpenAI Audio model now exposes all supported voices, giving text-to-speech builders the complete set instead of a mysteriously smaller shelf.

API keys now include last-used tracking and lifecycle controls, production-log scripts are easier for humans to read, and learn.js gained a Discord bot tutorial for people who would like their bot to leave the terminal occasionally.
